bhagavad-gita.title: Bhagavad Gita
bhagavad-gita.description: Divine wisdom through Lord Krishna's teachings on duty, purpose, and enlightenment.
bhagavad-gita.verse: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of action.

upanishads.title: Upanishads
upanishads.description: Philosophical treatises exploring the nature of Brahman and the self.
upanishads.verse: All this is Brahman. This Atman is Brahman.

ramayana.title: Ramayana
ramayana.description: Epic tale of Lord Rama embodying dharma, devotion, and righteousness.
ramayana.verse: One should never do that to another which one regards as injurious to one's own self.

mahabharata.title: Mahabharata
mahabharata.description: Epic narrative encompassing duty, karma, and the complexities of life.
mahabharata.verse: The soul is never born nor dies at any time. It has not come into being, does not come into being, and will not come into being.

hindu-philosophy.title: Hindu Philosophy
hindu-philosophy.description: Core philosophical schools and concepts within the Hindu tradition.
hindu-philosophy.verse: Tat Tvam Asi — That thou art.

tao-te-ching.title: Tao Te Ching
tao-te-ching.description: 81 chapters of poetic wisdom on living in harmony with the natural way.
tao-te-ching.verse: The Tao that can be told is not the eternal Tao.

zhuangzi.title: Zhuangzi
zhuangzi.description: Philosophical stories and parables exploring spontaneity and freedom.
zhuangzi.verse: I do not know whether I was then a man dreaming I was a butterfly, or whether I am now a butterfly dreaming I am a man.

liezi.title: Liezi
liezi.description: Ancient Taoist text on existence, fate, and spiritual transformation.
liezi.verse: The perfect man ignores self; the divine man ignores action; the true sage ignores reputation.

hua-hu-ching.title: Hua Hu Ching
hua-hu-ching.description: Lesser-known teachings of Lao Tzu on practical wisdom.
hua-hu-ching.verse: Return to the root of being and you will find the eternal.

i-ching.title: I Ching
i-ching.description: Ancient divination text exploring change and the flow of the universe.
i-ching.verse: Change is the only constant. Adapt and flow with the natural order.

dhammapada.title: Dhammapada
dhammapada.description: 423 verses on the path to enlightenment and ethical living.
dhammapada.verse: Mind is the forerunner of all actions. All deeds are led by mind, created by mind.

heart-sutra.title: Heart Sutra
heart-sutra.description: Core Mahayana text on emptiness, wisdom, and the nature of reality.
heart-sutra.verse: Form is emptiness, emptiness is form.

lotus-sutra.title: Lotus Sutra
lotus-sutra.description: One of the most influential Mahayana sutras on universal Buddha-nature.
lotus-sutra.verse: All living beings have the Buddha nature within them.

majjhima-nikaya.title: Majjhima Nikaya
majjhima-nikaya.description: Middle-length discourses of the Buddha on ethics, meditation, and wisdom.
majjhima-nikaya.verse: Better it is to live one day seeing the rise and fall of things than to live a hundred years without ever seeing the rise and fall of things.

tibetan-book-of-dead.title: Tibetan Book of the Dead
tibetan-book-of-dead.description: Guidance on consciousness, death, and the journey toward liberation.
tibetan-book-of-dead.verse: All conditioned things are impermanent. When one sees this with wisdom, one becomes disenchanted with suffering.

gospel-of-matthew.title: Gospel of Matthew
gospel-of-matthew.description: Account of Jesus's life, teachings, and the Sermon on the Mount.
gospel-of-matthew.verse: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

psalms.title: Psalms
psalms.description: 150 poetic hymns and prayers expressing devotion, gratitude, and lament.
psalms.verse: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

proverbs.title: Proverbs
proverbs.description: Practical wisdom on righteousness, discipline, and living a godly life.
proverbs.verse: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

gospel-of-john.title: Gospel of John
gospel-of-john.description: Spiritual account of Jesus emphasizing love, light, and eternal life.
gospel-of-john.verse: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

letters-of-paul.title: Letters of Paul
letters-of-paul.description: Epistles on faith, grace, love, and the nature of the Christian community.
letters-of-paul.verse: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

quran-al-fatiha.title: Al-Fatiha
quran-al-fatiha.description: The opening chapter — a prayer for guidance recited in every Muslim prayer.
quran-al-fatiha.verse: Guide us to the straight path — the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor.

quran-al-baqarah.title: Al-Baqarah
quran-al-baqarah.description: The longest surah covering faith, law, prayer, and moral guidance.
quran-al-baqarah.verse: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.

quran-al-imran.title: Al-Imran
quran-al-imran.description: Teachings on unity of God and steadfastness in faith.
quran-al-imran.verse: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided.

hadith-bukhari.title: Hadith — Sahih Bukhari
hadith-bukhari.description: Most authentic collection of the Prophet Muhammad's sayings and actions.
hadith-bukhari.verse: The best of people are those who are most beneficial to people.

rumi-masnavi.title: Masnavi — Rumi
rumi-masnavi.description: Six volumes of mystical Sufi poetry exploring love and divine union.
rumi-masnavi.verse: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing, there is a field. I'll meet you there.
